svg.title: Express Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 158-159, PDF 159-160. Interpreted longitudinal top projection from the illustration and six circular cross-section decks. Circular plans establish varying body diameters but do not specify longitudinal spacing; length-to-beam and taper are approximate illustration-based representation, not a dimensioned trace. Retains broad rounded forward capsule, tapering rear neck and simplified aft fins; no unsupported surface detail. Catalog sphere designation conflicts with elongated illustration and is not treated as geometry.
